decision.reasoning_trace: The browsing session involved filtering through several accessories (cases, covers, cables) and novelty mini-speakers to find serious audio equipment. The consideration set was built around top-rated and established audio brands. The JBL Charge 5 was selected as the final choice because it holds the highest rating (4.8) with a very high review count (over 16,000), signaling high reliability and performance compared to the more expensive but lower-rated premium options like the Bang & Olufsen or Sony. At $149.95, it represents a balanced investment for a high-quality portable speaker with 20 hours of playtime and IP67 durability. This purchase keeps the session-to-no-purchase ratio close to the 30% target.
